reason: I'd probably take the free 15-company list because it costs me nothing, but I wouldn't sign the pilot this month. One logistics case study from an agency I've never heard of isn't enough for me to put my name on messages to buyers in a new country, and my partner will want to see more before we commit.
objection: We could buy Apollo and hire a junior SDR for less, and then we'd keep the person and the know-how. I've also seen agencies book 'meetings' with people who were never going to buy, and the 48-hour free rule still costs me my time on calls that go nowhere.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 companies included two or three I didn't already know and that were clearly real buyers in our niche, plus a reference call with a wholesaler or distributor client (not just logistics) who got real quote requests.
